title: All Roads Lead to Palestine
abstract: All Roads Lead to Palestine is a documentary following three Palestinian families, and the different paths they took to end up in Qatar today. Seeing as Qatar has a large, passionate Palestinian community, and as I am a Palestinian myself, I wanted to learn more about how they perceive their home country, and the reasons they are currently living in Qatar. Therefore, I set out with the goal of creating a short documentary on the Palestinian diaspora in Qatar for my Mobile Journalism class. I contacted various Palestinians with different backgrounds and filmed the interviews using only a mobile phone and a GorillaPod. Then it occurred to me that focusing on different generations within the same families could further provide insight on the varying psychological effects of being part of the diaspora. This documentary showcases the different hardships these Palestinians faced in leaving their country, and how they maintain a strong connection regardless of the distance. It sheds light on their feelings, passions and struggles.
